description: The versioned, admin-defined questions, answer options and rules that produce a classification outcome. Data, not code. A rule set that has classified anything is locked; a change is a new version.

fields.description: Optional pre-filter over the subject record.
fields.label: Applies When

fields.description: Rule sets are versioned and never edited in place once used.
fields.label: Version Label

fields.description: Set the first time this rule set classifies a record. A sealed rule set cannot be edited; a change is a new version. (Named is_sealed, not is_locked: the framework's Document class already has an is_locked property and it would shadow the field.) Never copied: a duplicate is a new rule set that has classified nothing, so it starts unsealed.
fields.label: Sealed

fields.description: Returned when no rule matches. Must be the conservative outcome.
fields.label: Default Outcome

fields.description: Flattened onto the rule set and keyed by question_code: the framework does not support a table inside a table, so the model's nesting of options under questions is expressed with a key column instead.
fields.label: Answer Options

name: Classification Rule Set
